hunks.baseline: The thick mist of blood spreading in every direction wasn’t found only on the plateau west of the desert.
hunks.sol: The thick mist of blood spreading in every direction wasn’t confined to the plateau west of the desert.

hunks.baseline: The brutal scene unfolding in a basin a thousand li to the east was no different.
hunks.sol: A thousand li to the east, the scene unfolding in a basin was just as brutal.

hunks.baseline: *Crack!*
hunks.sol: *Crunch!*

hunks.baseline: Through the torrential rain, heavy enough to obscure the field, blood and chunks of flesh flew—no one could tell whose. Long, razor-sharp claws like scythes and finely honed spears and blades rushed at one another.
hunks.sol: Through rain heavy enough to obscure the field, blood and chunks of flesh flew—no one could tell whose. Long, scythe-sharp claws met finely honed spears and blades.

hunks.baseline: Arms and legs thick as logs. Three or four heads hanging from rotting bodies.
hunks.sol: Arms and legs thick as logs. Three or four heads hanging from each rotting body.

hunks.baseline: Their grotesque appearance inspired a primal fear, chilling the spine at a glance. But the low, deep sound that rang out the next moment snapped them back to their senses.
hunks.sol: The sight alone was enough to send a primal chill down anyone’s spine. But a low, deep sound rang out the next moment and snapped the soldiers back to their senses.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of strongmen poured all their strength into its thunderous beat, shaking the vast basin.
hunks.sol: Dozens of strongmen struck it with all their might, its thunderous beat shaking the vast basin.

hunks.baseline: At the forceful shout, a flag flapped in the rain.
hunks.sol: A flag snapped at the shouted command.

hunks.baseline: The tens of thousands of troops moved as one.
hunks.sol: Tens of thousands of troops moved as one.

hunks.baseline: The monsters’ claws tore into iron-plated shields instead of human flesh and bone. Spearmen arranged in a bristling formation thrust their long spears, each a zhang from end to end.
hunks.sol: The monsters’ claws tore into iron-plated shields instead of human flesh and bone. Spearmen packed together like the spines of a hedgehog thrust their long spears, each a zhang in length.

hunks.baseline: Fountains of blood erupted here and there.
hunks.sol: Fountains of blood erupted across the field.

hunks.baseline: Many monsters remained unmarked even by the sharpened spearheads. They smashed through the shield wall in their path and leaped into the gaps in the broken ranks.
hunks.sol: Many of the monsters didn’t suffer so much as a scratch from the sharpened spearheads. They smashed through the shield wall and leaped into the broken ranks.

hunks.baseline: Bodies that had been full of strength a moment ago were flung away as mere chunks of flesh. Those who witnessed the unreal sight remembered the fear they’d briefly forgotten.
hunks.sol: Men who had been full of strength moments ago were flung away like chunks of meat. Those who saw it happen remembered the fear they’d briefly forgotten.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of streaks of light plunged down from the sky, blocking the monsters’ endless charge.
hunks.sol: Dozens of streaks of light plunged down from above, blocking the monsters’ relentless charge.

hunks.baseline: They cut them down.
hunks.sol: Cutting it down.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers at the front, who’d only just escaped death, stared wide-eyed at the green blood spreading like mist.
hunks.sol: The soldiers at the front, who’d only just escaped death, stared wide-eyed at green blood spreading like mist.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, at the shadows descending over the monsters’ mangled corpses.
hunks.sol: More precisely, they stared at the shadows descending over the monsters’ severed corpses.

hunks.baseline: At the golden armor shining almost unnaturally bright—and at the man standing tall in the midst of those Embroidered Uniform Guards.
hunks.sol: At the golden armor shining almost unnaturally bright—and the man standing tall amid those Embroidered Uniform Guards.

hunks.baseline: They cried out, unable to hide their loyalty and reverence.
hunks.sol: They cried out with unmistakable loyalty and reverence.

hunks.baseline: They called to the sole ruler of the Nine Provinces and Eight Wastes, the Four Seas and Five Lakes, the father who governed all under heaven in accordance with the will of Heaven.
hunks.sol: They called to the sole ruler of the Nine Provinces and Eight Wastes, the Four Seas and Five Lakes. To the father who governed all under heaven in accordance with the will of Heaven.

hunks.baseline: In the most effective way possible for this urgent moment.
hunks.sol: In the most effective way he could at that moment.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s body shuddered. Its wings, unmistakably those of a hawk, were folded tight as it plunged from the sky like a bolt of lightning.
hunks.sol: A monster plunging from the sky like a bolt of lightning, its unmistakably hawklike wings folded tight, shuddered.

hunks.baseline: “How dare you charge at me?”
hunks.sol: “Who do you think you’re attacking?”

hunks.baseline: And yet this supreme being, someone they scarcely dared look up to, was fighting alongside them.
hunks.sol: And yet this supreme being, whom they scarcely dared look upon, was fighting alongside them.

hunks.baseline: Everything they needed to be willing to give their lives.
hunks.sol: Everything they needed to willingly give their lives.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds became thousands, then thousands became tens of thousands. At last, one unified roar rose up as the Imperial Army charged.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of voices became thousands, then tens of thousands. At last, one unified roar rose as the Imperial Army charged.

hunks.baseline: The answer came without a moment’s hesitation.
hunks.sol: He answered without a moment’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: “I will accept any punishment. But I beg Your Majesty to preserve your sacred person first, and carry out the sentence afterward.”
hunks.sol: “I will accept any punishment. But I beg Your Majesty to preserve your sacred person first and carry out the sentence afterward.”

hunks.baseline: The young officer’s manner was respectful yet unflinching. The Son of Heaven let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: The young officer was respectful yet unflinching. The Son of Heaven let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Wouldn’t it be a hundred times better for the laws of the imperial house to fall into disarray than for the imperial house itself to fall?”
hunks.sol: “Wouldn’t it be a hundred times better for its laws to fall into disarray than for the imperial house itself to fall?”

hunks.baseline: It was a disrespectful answer that could have seen him branded a traitor on the spot. Yet the Son of Heaven didn’t so much as raise an eyebrow.
hunks.sol: It was an answer that could have seen him branded a traitor on the spot. Yet the Son of Heaven didn’t so much as raise an eyebrow.

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man holding a silver crescent-bladed halberd was the most loyal subject in the world when it came to protecting the imperial house.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man holding a silver crescent-bladed halberd had done more than anyone under heaven to protect the imperial house.

hunks.baseline: Baek Yeon, Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, gave a simple military salute and corrected the Son of Heaven’s earlier words.
hunks.sol: Baek Yeon, Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, gave a brief military salute and corrected him.

hunks.baseline: “I had no choice.”
hunks.sol: “I had to.”

hunks.baseline: “Then why is Your Majesty, who ought to be in the safe rear, here?”
hunks.sol: “Then why is Your Majesty, who ought to be safely in the rear, here?”

hunks.baseline: “You’ve turned a foolish question into a wise answer. I have nothing more to say.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve answered a foolish question with a wise reply. I have nothing more to say.”

hunks.baseline: Just as Baek Yeon had come here to protect the Son of Heaven, the Son of Heaven had moved to protect the people who followed him.
hunks.sol: Just as Baek Yeon had come to protect the Son of Heaven, the Son of Heaven had come to protect the people who followed him.

hunks.baseline: Not for some grand cause, but out of compassion for his people.
hunks.sol: Not for some grand cause, but out of humanity.

hunks.baseline: *Compassion. Compassion…*
hunks.sol: *Humanity. Humanity…*

hunks.baseline: The Empire’s fourth prince, who’d once raced across battlefields on the strength of his burning blood and innate military talent, had disappeared after the dark shadow of Dark Heaven fell over the imperial house.
hunks.sol: The Empire’s fourth prince, who had once raced across battlefields with hot blood and a natural gift for war, had disappeared after Dark Heaven’s shadow fell over the imperial house.

hunks.baseline: The Son of Heaven had to be cold. He had to be heartless. He’d believed that was the right course—the only key that could solve every problem.
hunks.sol: The Son of Heaven had to be cold. He had to be heartless. He’d believed it was the right course—the only way to solve every problem.

hunks.baseline: At least, until a few months ago, when he met one man.
hunks.sol: At least until a few months ago, when he met one man.

hunks.baseline: No matter what stood in his way, he simply pushed forward with all his strength.
hunks.sol: No matter what stood in his way, he pushed forward with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: Was it because he was brave?
hunks.sol: Simply because he was brave?

hunks.baseline: Wrong.
hunks.sol: No.

hunks.baseline: He felt fear and pain just like everyone else—perhaps even more than they did. But he pressed on because he believed it was the compassionate thing to do.
hunks.sol: He felt fear and pain like everyone else—perhaps more than anyone. But he pressed on because he believed it was the human thing to do.

hunks.baseline: And in the end, it had reached everyone. It had led countless people all the way here.
hunks.sol: And in the end, it reached everyone. It had brought countless people all the way here.

hunks.baseline: With that mutter—one that would have sent the court into an uproar had the civil and military officials heard it—the Son of Heaven raised the sword he’d let hang at his side.
hunks.sol: That mutter would have thrown the court into an uproar had the civil and military officials heard it. The Son of Heaven raised the sword he’d let hang at his side.

hunks.baseline: Then he turned to the young Embroidered Uniform Guard officer who’d tried to stop him.
hunks.sol: Then he turned to the young Embroidered Uniform Guard officer who had tried to stop him.

hunks.baseline: “Has your resolve still not changed?”
hunks.sol: “Have you changed your mind?”

hunks.baseline: “Very well. I will withdraw in accordance with your wishes, at once. In return, you are not to leave my side for even a moment.”
hunks.sol: “Very well. I will withdraw as you wish, at once. You are not to leave my side for even a moment.”

hunks.baseline: “But the direction we withdraw will be forward—not back.”
hunks.sol: “But we will withdraw forward, not back.”

hunks.baseline: “I ask you again. Has your resolve still not changed?”
hunks.sol: “I ask you again. Have you changed your mind?”

hunks.baseline: After a moment’s silence, the young officer went down on one knee.
hunks.sol: After a moment’s silence, the young officer knelt.

hunks.baseline: The thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards who had now closed ranks around the Son of Heaven let out one mighty roar, and the battlefield shook.
hunks.sol: The thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards who had closed ranks around the Son of Heaven roared as one, shaking the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: Their cry swept over the heads of the Imperial Guards, whose lines were rapidly collapsing under the overwhelming odds, and reached even the true enemy lying in wait beyond them.
hunks.sol: Their cry swept over the heads of the Imperial Guards, whose lines were rapidly collapsing under the overwhelming odds, and reached the true enemy lying in wait beyond them.
*Thud. Thud.*

hunks.baseline: A dull thud rang out with each movement of the pitch-black armor that reflected no light.
hunks.sol: Pitch-black armor reflected no light. Each movement brought a dull, heavy sound.

hunks.baseline: Red eyes glowed beneath deeply lowered helmets. From the mouths visible below them came the stench of the dead.
hunks.sol: Red eyes glowed beneath helmets pulled low, and the mouths visible below them reeked of corpse stench.

hunks.baseline: Each one of them was a true monster, no different from a Supreme Peak master.
hunks.sol: True monsters, each one the equal of a Supreme Peak master.

hunks.baseline: When countless eyes began to tremble at the sight of no fewer than twenty of them, a thunderous cry burst from the Son of Heaven’s lips.
hunks.sol: Countless eyes trembled at the sight of no fewer than twenty of them. Then a thunderous cry burst from the Son of Heaven’s lips.

hunks.baseline: *Crack!*
hunks.sol: *Crunch!*

hunks.baseline: More than ten streaks of light shot up from across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: More than ten streaks of light shot up across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: Twelve men and women reached the Son of Heaven in an instant, crushing the monsters that stood in their way. They bowed deeply before him.
hunks.sol: Twelve men and women crushed the monsters in their path and reached the Son of Heaven in an instant. They bowed deeply before him.

hunks.baseline: After the bloodshed in the imperial palace, these Supreme Peak masters had been newly organized under the Son of Heaven’s command as a force directly under the imperial house. Their eyes shone brightly as they looked to their lord.
hunks.sol: After the bloodshed in the imperial palace, these Supreme Peak masters had been newly organized under the Son of Heaven’s command as a force directly serving the imperial house. Their eyes shone as they looked to their lord.

hunks.baseline: No—could anyone even dare to predict victory against enemies so terrifyingly powerful?
hunks.sol: No—could he even dare to hope for victory against enemies so terrifyingly powerful?

hunks.baseline: The Son of Heaven already knew the answer to the question that had suddenly come to mind.
hunks.sol: He already knew the answer to the question that had suddenly come to mind.

hunks.baseline: Even if that meant sending tens of thousands of Imperial Guards to their deaths.
hunks.sol: Even if it meant sending tens of thousands of Imperial Guards to their deaths.

hunks.baseline: But the actions of one man had changed more than just this world.
hunks.sol: But one man’s actions had changed more than the world around him.

hunks.baseline: Though he’d taken up the Maoshan Sect’s martial arts and his body was now no different from a dead man’s, his heart and blood burned hotter than ever.
hunks.sol: Though accepting the Maoshan Sect’s martial arts had left his body little different from a dead man’s, his heart and blood burned hotter than ever.

hunks.baseline: Just like everyone gathered here.
hunks.sol: Like everyone else here.

hunks.baseline: Just like the man who’d awakened him once again: Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Like the man who had awakened him: Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: And if that man were here, he would surely say this:
hunks.sol: And if Jin Taekyung were here, he would surely say this:

hunks.baseline: Feeling a freedom all the clearer for its utter lack of decorum, the Son of Heaven raced across the blood-soaked earth.
hunks.sol: The words held not a trace of decorum, and that made the freedom in them all the clearer. The Son of Heaven raced across the blood-soaked earth.

hunks.baseline: A brilliant golden wave stretched long behind him, like the tail of a meteor.
hunks.sol: A brilliant golden wave stretched out behind him like the tail of a meteor.

hunks.baseline: Two streaks of light had just passed across the sky, now black with night.
hunks.sol: Two streaks of light were crossing the sky, which had turned black before he’d noticed.

hunks.baseline: And yet, why?
hunks.sol: So why?

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung pressed down on his throbbing chest.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung pressed a hand to his throbbing chest.

hunks.baseline: For a long time, he couldn’t manage a proper night’s sleep.
hunks.sol: For a long time afterward, he couldn’t sleep properly.

hunks.baseline: Not after night gave way to dawn and the first light appeared. Not after he and his companions finally left that damned desert behind.
hunks.sol: Not when night gave way to dawn. Not when he and his companions finally left that damned desert behind.

hunks.baseline: Not even after they passed through mountains and fields blanketed in perennial snow, and reached the place where all the allied forces were supposed to rendezvous.
hunks.sol: Not even after they passed through mountains and fields blanketed in perennial snow and reached the place where all the allied forces were supposed to rendezvous.
